name: Muc tuoi
summary: Squid hand-lined from small day-boats. Báo Đồng Nai says the squid is still moving when it hits the tank, and that it cooks crisp with a deep sweet taste. Long-haul boats do not land the island’s fish, on that account. No price was printed.
origin: Côn Đảo. Small day-boats, Báo Đồng Nai, 11 July 2025.
texture: Báo Đồng Nai says the fresh squid cooks crisp.
taste: Báo Đồng Nai says a deep sweet taste.
howToEat: Choose it fresh. Báo Bà Rịa–Vũng Tàu says the night market steams or grills the seafood you pick, and names squid among the animals on the stalls.
Dried squid and one-sun squid are separate packs. The market opens at 17:00. A squid price was not printed. Check on arrival.
where: Chợ đêm Côn Đảo, on Võ Thị Sáu and Phạm Văn Đồng, in front of the daily market.
